text: WONTFIX 2026-05-12 -- mechanical cascade per this bead's own description. PKIX-fmtv.6 closed as B (parallel pipeline); the bead body says: 'If option B (parallel pipeline), this child closes as WONTFIX and pkix-lint stays standalone.' No adapter type to implement. pkix-lint::LintRunner remains the only way to run lints; pkix-chain's verify_* wrappers do not invoke it. Composition pattern (caller invokes verify_* then LintRunner) is documented in PKIX-fmtv.6's decision comment. If a thin pkix_chain::verify_and_lint() convenience function is desired later, file it as a new bead -- not part of this child's scope.
